query:
SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.sponsorId,
  s.name as sponsorName,
  s.attendee1Id,
  s.attendee2Id,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.attendeeUserId,
  m.timeSlot,
  m.matchScore,
  m.delegateId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.isVisible = 1
ORDER BY m.sponsorId, m.timeSlot;
